how: Recruitment calls seek hands to revive and spread a consuming colour faction without demonstrating uptake by placing.
Members judge target feasibility relative to defenders rather than only the size of their desired mark.
A damage report does not identify which recruitment call produced the reported placing.
Members request explanations of joining and mobile controls without the coded questions proving that answers arrived.
Participants announce departure over destruction and report leaving after organizational conflict without establishing personal exhaustion.
A member proposes a target for a new core while the separate joining response remains outside the starter role.
Proposal and recruitment share one turn while the later response is joining rather than a separately ordered recruitment call.
An acceptance requesting coordinates receives the exact location in the next reply.
A participant accepts a redirect with bare assent and reports the former location gone.
A redirect receives local assent without establishing the prevalence of bare answers across the room.
Team proposals, allocated portions and polls make this an evidenced local exception without disputing the aggregate frequency across rooms.
Reported official plans, credited pushes and divided directions establish locally effective coordination alongside contested chat authority.
A participant reports leaders overriding a rejected vote and banning criticism while their internal deliberation remains unavailable.
Members withhold an attack location and claim access to rival plans without establishing the success of an intrusion.
Members circulate a customizable script and report modifying hostile bots to place black.
Scripts and hostile automation are present but the cited passages do not establish upkeep exhaustion causing adoption.
Manual tactics attack correctly coloured defender pixels and leave other colours for defenders to spend placements replacing.
Advice for consuming while asleep accommodates sleep without establishing actual overnight placing or an individual schedule.
Members advise refreshing a stale canvas and report a vanished cooldown without establishing that apparent extra pixels reached the canvas.
Participants dispute permanent cores, signatures and multicoloured static as forms of the room's mark.
Coordinates and competing appearance proposals do not establish deliberation being settled by a shared template.
Some members explicitly stop growth to defend and purify a fixed core.
Keeping a fixed core describes one option because other participants reject cleaning and prioritize consuming movement.
Keeping follows building only for participants who value retaining the core rather than completing consumption and allowing replacement work.
Purity demands and welcomes for new art do not identify a shared agreed change, so the added uninformed-repair mechanism remains locally untested.
Members report active damage during the contest rather than only remembering it after closure.
Participants attribute loss to scattered attacks and division to leaders while these remain causal allegations rather than independent findings.
Ceasefire and treaty announcements coexist with doctrinal opposition to alliances rather than establishing a single accepted policy.
Restraint calls protect particular works and memorials or redirect effort away from defenders judged too strong.
An outsider offers conditional help while another requester is required to contribute labour and prove commitment.
An alliance announcement establishes coalition talk without confirming durable coordinated defence.
A self-identified envoy brings another room's protest about destroyed work into this room.
A participant identifies with both the consuming faction and a named targeted community without the concept establishing reassurance or reconciled loyalties.
Members select weak or already-black ground without waiting for a loss at the proposed site.
A report that a location is lost explicitly accompanies an order to retreat.
The retreat passage does not establish a prior judgment of insufficient hands as its mechanism.
Challenges to destruction receive renewal and teamwork explanations while a competing doctrine makes consumption itself the sole goal.
Permission requests approach asking for space but do not locate another room's guest work on a governed host mark.
The agreement appeal survives but its pruned replies do not preserve the alleged response denying binding authority.
The agreement appeal does not establish either an after-agreement authority dispute or the revised at-agreement exceptions.
Treaty announcements do not establish upkeep pressure as the cause of border negotiations.
Invoking a prior agreement to stop attacking does not show that placers subsequently observed restraint.
A proposal to use others for defence and an outsider's offer do not demonstrate shortage causing help to arrive.
A conditional help offer does not demonstrate that an earlier border negotiation opened the exchange.
Alliance talk does not establish pressure maintaining a core causing coordinated mutual defence.
Members enact a colour faith and declare conversions without the evidence requiring an inherited national or fandom identity.
Members create related organizing homes and promise a hive mind without establishing the original room's undocumented formation or universal migration.
Colour faith authorizes incompatible practices because negotiation refusal, renewal and pure consumption remain disputed participant doctrines.
Current target and identity claims cannot date an inherited quarrel in the absence of a pre-event baseline.
Equal-consumption claims do not establish antecedent ties or rule out individual inherited rivalries.
Members propose canvas wordplay and repeat a slogan alteration without proving adoption by other participants.
A reply exposes the logic of a gender taunt without explicitly condemning offence or establishing a moderation norm.
A situation-room master thread and structural announcement establish venue organization without proving enforced removals or displaced ordinary activity.
Recruitment calls and structural announcements do not establish a call flood causing containment of canvas talk.
An individual's April Fools characterization does not establish a host takeover or one-day parody frame.
Departure over destroyed artwork does not establish attacking the room's own mark because canvas posts annoyed the speaker.
A member honours every black pixel and participant rather than only a surviving finished picture.
Defeat claims receive a retrospective defence of temporary black masses and dynamic timelapse work.
Pride in participation does not establish a finished-state report causing celebration.
Pride and timelapse accounts coexist without a passage establishing celebration as the cause of recording.
A cleaned final version prompts competing accounts of chaos as art and utter darkness as the goal.
Participants carry recruitment, core creation and defence onto successor canvases after original placement ends.
Successor continuation is not equivalent for participants who consider the original time limit essential.
Original shutdown explicitly prompts migration into renewed placing while a successor defence report ends under attack again.
The migration post explicitly names closure while recording is not established as its cause.
A proposed signature and calling-sign rationale establish recruitment intention without identifying observed arrivals through the mark.
Reports of celebrity or streamer backing do not establish outreach presenting the work to an external audience.
Calls to attack can constitute building a core through another work's existing black pixels.
Target selection exploits inactive defence and existing black ground without requiring an inherited rivalry.
The mobilizing call can already demand consumption rather than first gather hands for a separate constructive project.
An expansion call receives refusal explicitly justified by the work others invested in the threatened area.
An appeal invokes a prior agreement to stop an attack without establishing subsequent compliance.
Verbal contest includes invitations to fight back and a post-event salute.
Separate invitations to fight and post-event salutes do not establish a causal chain from a particular attack.
Accepting a call can open an instruction exchange rather than end in a response asking for nothing back.
Participants say access problems block contribution and anti-spy closure removes organization, identifying an access dependence without measuring its effect.
Participants justify pure visible cores as calling signs attracting unaffiliated sympathizers without demonstrating the proposed recruitment effect.

statement: Consuming and moving on after declared completion
how: Mobility can continue the consuming practice after a declared success rather than relocate after loss or adjust a construction site.
